concepts.title: Pure Editorial
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the provided approved pause-menu concept into one refined variation. Preserve EXACT forest backdrop, mannequin pose and position, camera framing, landscape aspect ratio. Keep the same minimal high-end editorial design family: huge elegant thin high-contrast serif PAUSED title at upper-left, vertical left-hand menu, translucent softly feathered charcoal darkness on left fading into blurred forest; neutral white typography, restrained purple star selection, abundant open right half. All English text exactly: PAUSED, Resume, Inventory, Journal, Settings, Quit to Menu; small Esc Resume bottom-left. Do not add cards, opaque panels, weapon icons, ornate frames, extra options or busy constellations. Smooth high-quality lines and polished typography. One full-screen concept, not collage. Replace the old concept number/title with the new small variation label specified below. Keep other aspects stable except the specific art direction below.
Specific direction: Closest to the reference: refine the huge tall Didone PAUSED typography with crisp hairlines and generous negative space below. Keep the horizontal violet star pointer left of Resume, reduce its glow to a delicate soft halo. Slightly stronger menu text contrast. Tiny top label '01 — PURE EDITORIAL'.
